Original, unmodified one-page [[Players Committee]] PDF titled ''Virtual Set #1 Premium Edition'', containing twelve lower-card slips for [[Virtual Set 1: Legacy#Premium Edition|Virtual Set 1: Legacy (Premium Edition)]].

Source: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards1Premium.pdf VirtualCards1Premium.pdf], Players Committee. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008193754/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards1Premium.pdf Internet Archive]. Printed footer year: 2002. PDF metadata records creation on 3 February 2005; that metadata is not a stated release date.

Original filename: <code>VirtualCards1Premium.pdf</code>. Size: 361,922 bytes. SHA-256: <code>233bb5bcb8fedf14baaa6a65645e488ec2d1dad34dbefd22570edd6324bf1aeb</code>.

The original bytes are retained unchanged. The twelve card articles use extractions of this sheet, not wiki-made full-card reconstructions.
